projects.name: Cora Merrick Park
projects.developer: Constellation Group and the Boschetti Group
projects.summary: Constellation Group and Boschetti Group secured a $67.5 million construction loan for Cora Merrick Park, a 74-unit luxury condo development in Coral Gables. This wellness-focused project broke ground two months prior and is located across from Shops at Merrick Park.

projects.name: Virginia Key Marinas Redevelopment
projects.summary: Miami City Commissioners are set to reconsider an $80 million proposal to redevelop the Virginia Key marinas, a plan that has been delayed by lawsuits for nearly a decade. The commission will decide if residents should vote on the proposal by Virginia Key LLC to revitalize the waterfront area.

projects.name: Prospera Real Estate Collective Coconut Grove Condos
projects.summary: Developer Ellen Buckley's Prospera Real Estate Collective plans a five-story, 56-unit condo building in Miami's Coconut Grove. This project is part of a broader initiative to develop affordable and workforce housing in Miami-Dade County to address the regional housing crunch.

projects.name: Prospera Real Estate Collective Miami-Dade Townhomes
projects.summary: Prospera Real Estate Collective, led by Ellen Buckley, plans to develop 37 for-sale townhomes across 14 buildings in Miami-Dade County. This initiative aims to address the region's affordable housing crunch by offering homes at below-market sale prices.

projects.name: Pablo Castro's Live Local Act Megaproject
projects.developer: Pablo Castro, Digital Housing Platform entity
projects.scale: Miami-Dade County’s largest Live Local Act project (megaproject)
projects.summary: Spanish developer Pablo Castro's proposed megaproject, intended to be Miami-Dade County’s largest Live Local Act development, is currently facing its third lawsuit. The Miami Gardens Chamber of Commerce is among those suing Castro and his Digital Housing Platform entity over alleged trade secret misappropriation for the planned complex.

projects.name: Alhambra Parc
projects.summary: MG Developer and Vertical Developments secured a $100 million construction loan from Benmark Capital for Alhambra Parc, a 74-unit luxury mixed-use condo project in Coral Gables. The development is located at 33 Alhambra Circle, just north of the downtown core.

projects.name: Miami International Airport Modernization in Action Plan
projects.summary: Miami International Airport acquired a 68,000-square-foot industrial warehouse for $19.2 million. This property will serve as storage and a construction staging site, supporting the airport's extensive $14 billion 'Modernization in Action Plan' expansion initiatives over the next decade.

projects.name: Lotis Wellington
projects.developer: Development partner (name not specified due to infighting)
projects.scale: Mixed-use community with residences, retail, restaurants, and offices
projects.summary: The Lotis Wellington mixed-use project, which received zoning approval six years ago, was planned as an ambitious community featuring residences, retail, restaurants, and offices. Although partly finished, the development is now entangled in developer infighting and faces over $5 million in liens from unpaid bills.

projects.name: Polo West Golf Course Redevelopment
projects.summary: BH Group finalized the nearly $21 million acquisition of the 150.5-acre Polo West Golf Course in Wellington, Palm Beach County. The purchase, which followed a settlement of litigation with seller Glenn Straub, signals the imminent redevelopment of this significant shuttered golf course site.

projects.name: Coral Gables City Hall Renovation
projects.summary: A multi-million dollar renovation of the historic Coral Gables City Hall is slated to commence. This significant public project aims to upgrade the iconic municipal building, representing a key investment in the city's infrastructure and heritage.

projects.name: NoBe Parc Miami Beach
projects.summary: Robert Finvarb Companies is launching sales for NoBe Parc Miami Beach, a 15-story, 232-unit short-term rental-friendly condo building planned for 7140 Abbott Avenue. This project marks a significant new residential development in North Beach.

projects.name: Brickell Key Seawall and Baywalk Replacement
projects.summary: Condo owners on Brickell Key are suing Swire Properties over a $32.3 million assessment to repair and rebuild the island’s seawall and baywalk. This major infrastructure renovation project is planned, but its funding mechanism is currently under legal dispute.

projects.name: Raleigh Miami Beach Expansion
projects.summary: Nahla Capital is seeking city approval for an expansion plan for the Raleigh Miami Beach redevelopment, aiming to increase the floor area ratio by adding over 66,000 square feet. The plan is scheduled for a vote by the Miami Beach Planning Board on June 2.

projects.name: Raleigh Miami Beach expansion plan
projects.scale: adding more than 66,000 sqft of floor area
projects.summary: Nahla Capital is seeking approval from the Miami Beach City Commission to expand the Raleigh Miami Beach redevelopment. The plan involves comprehensive plan and code amendments to increase the floor area ratio, which would add over 66,000 square feet to the project.

projects.name: Marina Village
projects.summary: Forest Development was selected by Riviera Beach city council to undertake a $556.1 million phased development at Marina Village. The project encompasses 12 acres of city-owned waterfront, forming part of a larger 80-acre site intended for significant redevelopment.

projects.name: Portofino Hollywood
projects.summary: Related Group secured approval from the Hollywood City Commission for a revised plan for its Portofino Hollywood beachfront residential development. The project was modified to include workforce housing rentals, utilizing the state's Live Local Act for expedited approval.
